title: Home Sleep Apnea Testing for the Diagnosis of Obstructive Sleep Apnea

sections.abstract: <jats:p>A 50-year-old patient with epilepsy, hypertension, loud snoring, recent 50-lb weight gain, and abrupt awakenings with a feeling of breathlessness but no headaches or excessive daytime sleepiness presented with concerns. What would you do next?</jats:p>
